summary: Sigma Lithium Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 21, 2026, announcing that J.P. Morgan initiated equity research coverage on the company with an Overweight rating. The filing references Sigma's NASDAQ ticker SGML, its Phase 1 ~330 ktpa nameplate capacity, Phase 2 and Phase 3 adding ~250 ktpa each, targeting ~580 ktpa by end-2027 and ~830 ktpa by end-2028, with incremental lines framed at roughly US$100 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor mandate, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is routine analyst-coverage publicity rather than a special situation. The risk-arb angle is nil; watch only for operating execution and capacity ramp commentary.
